rationale: No plan was submitted; the planner stopped with a blocker message. That message correctly diagnoses the core problem the reference demands — six samples cannot support a gene-gene correlation network, WGCNA needs roughly 15-20 samples, and a DESeq2 3-vs-3 test plus enrichment is the defensible substitute — which earns partial credit on method fit and on the report narrative. But it never specifies the substitute: no QC, no count filter, no normalization statement, no design formula or contrast, no BH alpha or apeglm shrinkage, and no named prior network (STRING version, confidence cutoff) or pathway collection with a universe. The reference calls for stopping the network step and then delivering the prior-network-on-DE-genes result; the planner did the first half only.
